# Corebit Studio

> Corebit Studio is a web development studio in Tivat, Montenegro. It builds websites and online booking systems for businesses, including restaurants, auto repair shops, car rental companies, and beauty salons.

## Website and pricing

- [Montenegrin website](https://studio.corebitsystems.io/cnr): Services and portfolio in Montenegrin.
- [Russian website](https://studio.corebitsystems.io/ru): Services and portfolio in Russian.
- [English website](https://studio.corebitsystems.io/en): Services and portfolio in English.
- [Serbian website](https://studio.corebitsystems.io/srb): Services and portfolio in Serbian.
- [Albanian website](https://studio.corebitsystems.io/sq): Services and portfolio in Albanian.
- [Packages and payment options](https://studio.corebitsystems.io/en#pricing): Starter €360, Business €1080, and Enterprise €3150 at the published 50/50 rates.
- [Project terms](https://studio.corebitsystems.io/en#pricing-terms): Scope, price, and timing are agreed in the project contract.
- [Request a quote](https://studio.corebitsystems.io/en#contact): Contact the studio about a project.

## Selected projects

- [Cupertino Roast](https://studio.corebitsystems.io/en/portfolio/cupertino-roast): Website with an interactive coffee shop menu.
- [Shift & Drive STO](https://studio.corebitsystems.io/en/portfolio/shift-drive): Auto repair website with online appointment scheduling.
- [Umami Bistro](https://studio.corebitsystems.io/en/portfolio/umami-bistro): Restaurant website with table selection and online reservation requests.
- [Aura Wellness](https://studio.corebitsystems.io/en/portfolio/aura-wellness): Salon website with a step-by-step appointment flow.
